name: Meem Arafat Manab
position: Deputy Coordinator - Event and Project Management
about: Meem is a postgraduate student and researcher based at Dublin City University and University of León, and a proud student of the second cohort of European Master in Law, Data and AI. He saddles the two interlacing disciplines of data science and socio-legal research, and his previous research works have been published in Nature Scientific Communications and conferences of IEEE and ACM among others.

name: NAWRIN AKTER
about: Nawrin Akter holds an MBA in Finance and HR, as well as a Bachelor degree in Buddhism. Currently, she is an Erasmus Mundus Scholar in the MAGMA program, specializing in Managing Art and Cultural Heritage in Global Markets. Previously, Nawrin was an ICCR Scholar (full-funded Indian Government Scholarship) at North Eastern Hill University, Shillong, India. She has several volunteering experience in non-profit organisations.

name: Md Walid Hossain Talukder
position: Deputy Coordinator - IT and Web Design
about: Just a chill guy who loves trying out many things

name: Ridoy Karmoker Rudro
position: Deputy Coordinator - Graphics and Social Media
about: A self-motivated individual with a knack for keeping things simple and effective.

name: Reshma Haque
position: Deputy Coordinator - Outreach and Public Relationship
about: A highly motivated and intuitive Erasmus Mundus-award Scholar of Economic Policy for the Global Transition (EPOG+) who desires to explore the knowledge of an expert in economic policy in the global market that will boost the long-term growth of sustainable development in quality education.

name: Mehdi Hassan Milu
about:
I am Mehdi Hassan Milu, currently pursuing the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Degree in Technology and Management for Circular Economy (IMATEC) as an Erasmus Scholar (2024–26) at the University of Chemistry and Technology (Czech Republic), University of Oviedo (Spain), and Abo Akademi University (Finland). Additionally, I hold the position of Deputy Coordinator of the Students and Alumni unit within the Erasmus Mundus Association of Bangladesh (EMA-BD).

I have completed my BSc in Chemical Engineering at the University of Debrecen in Hungary, funded by the Hungarian Government. I was honoured to receive an Innovation Fellowship from the Hungarian Innovation Centre for working on biodegradable plastics and an Entrepreneurial Award from the University of Debrecen in Hungary. Previously, I was also an Officer Cadet at the Bangladesh Military Academy and served in the Bangladesh Army for several years.

Apart from academics, I contributed as a mentor and an Erasmus buddy with the Stipendium Hungaricum Mentor Network and the Erasmus Student Network (ESN) in Hungary and Czech Republic. I am passionate about investigating natural resources, entrepreneurship, and management for developing and implementing an advanced and brilliant circular economy. To those aspiring to pursue similar opportunities, I encourage you to embrace challenges and uncertainties, as these experiences can shape you into a resilient, well-rounded individual ready to seize future opportunities.

name: Mahima Haque
position: Deputy Coordinator - Graphics and Social Media
about: I have completed my undergraduate studies in Aeronautical Engineering from Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST). During this time, I realized that I have a keen passion for material science and processing technologies. Hence, I chose to pursue my Master studies in this field. I have been selected for the Erasmus Mundus Master in Advanced Materials Science and Engineering (AMASE). My first university is Saarland University in Germany and my second university is Montanuniversität Leoben in Austria. I love to learn new things, meet people from different cultures and travel to different places. I eagerly look forward to contributing to the EMA-BD team and help more students achieve this wonderful opportunity of an Erasmus Mundus Scholarship.

name: Abu Touhid Hossain
about: Touhid completed his master’s through the prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship in Euro Hydroinformatics and Water Management (2022-2024). He studied in Spain, the UK, and Germany, along with a two-week course in France. Currently, he works at the Dutch company Global Center on Adaptation as a Junior Program Officer in Dhaka. Outside of work, he loves exploring new cities and engaging in conversations about nature and technology.

name: Prangon Das
about: Completing my B.Sc. Engineering degree from the Department of Mechatronics Engineering, Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET), I started my career as an intern in the Grameenphone Ltd. After that, I started my post-graduation (ongoing) in M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET). On June 01, 2023, I joined as a Lecturer in the Department of Mechatronics Engineering, RUET. Currently, I have received the prestigious Erasmus Mundus Scholarship and is on study leave to complete my Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree in Europe. I'm also looking forward to achieve a successful position to utilize my skills and abilities to work innovatively in the fields of automation, robotics, machine vision, renewable energy systems and control systems analysis and research.

name: MD MEHEDI HASSAN SHARIF
position: Deputy Coordinator - Graphics and Social Media
about: I am highly enthusiastic about sustainable agriculture and plant health, especially in integrated pest management and phytochemical research. Currently, I am enrolled in the Erasmus Mundus Plant Health program, where I am exploring the sustainable approach to plant protection and innovative approaches to pest control. As a member of EMA BD, I will contribute to the graphics design and social media sector of our organization, creating visuals and managing outreach to strengthen our community presence. Outside of my work, I enjoy traveling, photography, and exploring diverse cultures.

name: Mohammad Imran Hossain
about: I am a distinguished recipient of the Erasmus Mundus Scholarship for the 2022-2024 cohort. I graduated from the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Medical Imaging and Applications (MAIA) in 2024. Throughout this master's program, I studied at the University of Burgundy (France), the University of Cassino and Southern Lazio (Italy), and the University of Girona (Spain). I conducted my master's thesis at the prestigious National Center for Scientific Research (France).

name: Sharif Mutasim Billah
position: Deputy Coordinator - Outreach and Public Relationship
about: I am Sharif Mutasim Billah, currently serving as the Deputy Coordinator of the Public Relations Team for Erasmus Mundus Association Bangladesh. With a background in environmental science, I am passionate about creating meaningful connections and fostering engagement within the Erasmus community. My role involves enhancing visibility, building networks, and promoting the impact of Erasmus Mundus programs across Bangladesh. I take pride in representing a global initiative that champions education, collaboration, and cultural exchange.

name: Fairooz Azim
about: I am currently a second year student at the University of Malta, studying the Erasmus Mundus program Language and Communication Technologies. Before that, I finished my first year at the University of Lorraine. I am enthusiastic about Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing and the application of these technologies to solve real life problems. In my free time, I love to explore the world, read books, make paintings.

name: Nafisa Nawal Huda
about: I completed my master’s in Advanced Materials Science and Engineering (AMASE) (Sweden, Germany). My international experience inspired me to strengthen connections between alumni and students. As a Deputy Coordinator, I aim to support engagement and community-building initiatives.

name: Saad Bin Ekram
position: Deputy Coordinator - Event and Project Management
about: I'm Saad, currently pursuing an Erasmus Mundus Master of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology. With a background in Electrical Engineering, I'm passionate about technological advancement and innovation. My future career plans involve contributing to cutting-edge research and development in the semiconductor industry, where I aim to help shape the future of electronics. Outside of work, I enjoy watching movies, meeting new people, playing sports, and travelling, which keeps me balanced and inspired. I'm always eager to connect with like-minded individuals and explore new opportunities!

name: Tutul Kumar Saha
about: Myself SAHA, currently enrolling Erasmus program MER2030. Soon will start my thesis semester under the Baltic sea research institute (IOW) in Rostock, Germany.

name: SM FAYSAL AHMED
position: Deputy Coordinator - Event and Project Management
about:
I am SM Faysal Ahmed, with an academic background in Mechanical Engineering and a strong passion for international education and cross-cultural collaboration. My journey with EMA-BD began in 2024 as the Deputy Coordinator of Event and Project Management, where I successfully led key initiatives, including organizing impactful webinars, hosting events, and fostering community engagement. These experiences have helped me develop expertise in project coordination, event planning, and community building.

As I continue my contributions in the 2025 term, I aim to build on these achievements by driving innovative projects and strengthening EMA-BD’s outreach. I aim to inspire more students and professionals in Bangladesh to embrace international opportunities and thrive in a globally connected world.

name: MD ABDUR RAHMAN
about: An experienced volunteer specializing in IT, social media. With a proven track record of managing digital platforms, creating impactful content, and providing technical support.

name: Jahid Hasan Jony
position: Deputy Coordinator - IT and Web Design
about:
Graduate in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) | Master's Candidate in Communications Engineering & Data Science (CODAS) 

Currently pursuing a double degree master's program in Communications Engineering and Data Science, with a strong focus on Bioinformatics. With a solid foundation in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), my academic journey is centered around blending cutting-edge communications and data science technologies to solve complex healthcare challenges. I am passionate about the intersection of bioinformatics, data analytics, and engineering solutions that drive innovation and improve quality of life.

name: Mahdi Islam
position: Deputy Coordinator - IT and Web Design
about: A science-technology enthusiast persevering to learn new skills to co-exist in the ever changing society. Eager to contribute to team success through hard work, leadership and research skills.

name: SK Fahim Tahmid Boni
about: I am currently doing my Erasmus Mundus Program at University of Barcelona. I have completed my first year of Masters Degree at University of Algarve and my undergraduate degree at RUET, Bangladesh.

name: Mohammad Zafar Iqbal
about: Mohammad Zafar Iqbal is a marine biologist pursuing an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s Degree in Aquaculture, Environment & Society (ACES STAR). He specializes in fish and bivalve reproductive physiology, algal ecotoxicology, and aquaculture systems. Zafar holds a Master’s and Bachelor’s degree in Fisheries from CVASU, Bangladesh, and has contributed to research on hormonal effects in zebrafish, catfish body shape plasticity, and seaweed farming. His work has led to multiple publications and conference presentations. Committed to advancing sustainable aquaculture, Zafar aims to drive innovative research and solutions for global food security and marine ecosystem conservation.

name: Abdullah Mahmud Alauddin
position: Deputy Coordinator - Outreach and Public Relationship
about: Language and linguistics enthusiast

name: Fahmida Yeasmin
about: I am a graduate of the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master’s Degree (EMJMD) in Groundwater and Global Change (2022-2024 cohort), with a solid academic foundation in Geography and Environmental Studies from the University of Chittagong. As an Erasmus Mundus scholar, I had the privilege of immersing myself in diverse cultural and academic environments, which deepened my passion for interdisciplinary exploration. My research centres on environmental changes and water security, and I am motivated by a strong desire to contribute to a sustainable future for all.

name: Sadad Mahamud
about:
Sadad Mahamud is an Erasmus Mundus scholar and a passionate advocate for international education and collaboration. He completed his Joint International Master in Smart Systems Integrated Solutions (SSIs) through the Erasmus Mundus program, studying at Aalto University (Finland), the University of South-Eastern Norway, and the Budapest University of Technology and Economics.

As a professional, Sadad brings expertise in computer networks, IoT, embedded systems, and ICT, with a strong background in programming and research. He has worked as an IT and Social Media Coordinator for EMA BD, developing its official website and managing digital outreach to foster connections between prospective and alumni students.

Currently, Sadad serves as the Country Representative for Erasmus Mundus Association Bangladesh, where he actively promotes the program and supports the Bangladeshi Erasmus community. He is committed to inspiring future scholars to pursue global opportunities and believes in the transformative power of higher education.

name: Shouvik Roy Snigdha
about:
I am currently working as an Administrative Officer at the Office of the International Affairs, Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. My role involves managing Erasmus+ mobility programs, visa arrangements and event coordination. I coordinate the entire Erasmus+ exchange program process, from application to departure, ensuring a seamless experience for students and staff.
I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering and a Master’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), both from Daffodil International University. My academic journey includes invaluable yearlong international exposure through the Erasmus+ program. In 2016-2017, I studied at the University of Évora, Portugal for one year as an Erasmus scholar under the LEADER project, which broadened my academic and cultural perspectives. In 2023, I further enhanced my professional expertise as an Erasmus staff scholar at the Silesian University of Technology, Poland.
My experiences have shaped my passion for fostering global connections and facilitating cross-cultural exchange. I am dedicated to supporting students, faculty, and staff in their internationalization journeys, ensuring they thrive both academically and culturally. Through my work, I strive to promote educational enrichment and build strong global partnerships for Daffodil International University.
